nearby.withTeammatesLine: Phones that already have LangQuest bring each other up to date.
nearby.newPersonLine: Give a new person the app, then let them join the team from this phone.
nearby.rowSub: Share work with teammates without internet
nearby.rowSubJoin: Share work with teammates, or bring in a new person, without internet
nearby.rowHelp: Opens Share nearby, where phones near each other share work without internet.
nearby.rowHelpJoin: Opens Share nearby, where phones near each other share work without internet, and where you give a new person the app and let them join the team.

why.notInBuild: This version of the app cannot share nearby. Update it from the store.
why.androidTooOld: Share nearby needs Android 10 or later, and this phone has an older version.
why.noBluetoothLe: This phone has no Bluetooth Low Energy, which Share nearby needs.
why.noWifiDirect: This phone has no Wi-Fi Direct, which Share nearby needs.
why.noKey: This phone is not ready to share yet. Connect to the internet once, then come back.
why.noCertificate: To share nearby, this phone must connect to the internet once while your organization has Share nearby turned on.
why.limited: This account set up too many new phones today. Share nearby works on this phone from tomorrow.
why.readOnly: Accounts that only view organizations do not share nearby.

radios.title: Turn these on in your phone's settings, then come back:

permission.location: Android calls finding nearby phones "location". LangQuest does not record where you are. It uses this only to find teammates' phones while this screen is open.
permission.nearbyAndLocation: Android will ask twice: to find nearby devices, then for location, which Wi-Fi Direct needs. LangQuest does not record where you are.
permission.nearbyDevices: Android will ask to let LangQuest find and connect to nearby devices. It uses this only while this screen is open.
permission.precise: Android gave only approximate location, and Wi-Fi Direct needs precise location to connect. LangQuest still does not record where you are.
permission.bluetooth: Your iPhone will ask to let LangQuest use Bluetooth to find teammates' phones. It uses this only while this screen is open. When the phones connect, it may also ask to find devices on your local network and to join a teammate's Wi-Fi. Allow those too, so recordings can come across.
permission.settings: Android will not ask again. Open this app's settings, then Permissions, and allow Nearby devices or Location.
permission.settingsIphone: Your iPhone will not ask again. Open this app's settings and turn on Bluetooth, and Local Network if it is there.
permission.allowHelp: Shows Android's question. Choose Allow to share with teammates nearby.
permission.allowHelpIphone: Shows your iPhone's question. Choose Allow to share with teammates nearby.
permission.openSettingsHelp: Opens this app's page in your phone's settings, where you can allow it.

stopped.idle: Stopped after a while with nobody new nearby.
stopped.wait: Stopped after waiting a long time for a busy teammate.
stopped.failed: Share nearby could not start Bluetooth and Wi-Fi.
stopped.lookAgainLine: If a teammate arrives, tap Look again.

nearby.lookAgainHelp: Turns on Bluetooth and Wi-Fi again to find teammates nearby.
nearby.findError: Bluetooth stopped working ({{code}}). Turn Bluetooth off and on again.
nearby.looking: Looking for teammates. Keep this screen open, and ask them to open Share nearby too.
nearby.upToDateLine: This phone is up to date with everyone nearby.

state.missed: Did not finish. It will try again.

nearby.connectHelp: Connects to this phone. Use it when a teammate is nearby but the phones have not found each other.
nearby.connectHelpAll: Connects to every teammate's phone nearby that has not found this one. One tap covers them all until you leave this screen.

came.title: What was shared
came.guideFilesShort: Guide pictures and audio that did not fit: {{n}}
came.noRoom: This phone ran out of room for recordings.
came.cutBackups: Backups paused so a waiting teammate could have a turn.
came.dropped: The connection dropped before the end.
came.noAnswer: The other phone did not answer.
came.heard: The other phone ended it early.
came.failed: Something went wrong. It will try again.

nearby.clockOff: A teammate's clock and this phone's differ by more than five minutes. Check the date and time on both phones.
nearby.newerApp: This phone's app and a teammate's are too far apart in version to share. Update the older one from the store, or from the other phone's install file.
nearby.newerAppIphone: This phone's app and a teammate's are too far apart in version to share. Update the older one from the store.

copy.lost: An app update removed the team's work this phone got from a teammate. Stay near a teammate with Share nearby open to get it again.
copy.short: This phone does not have all of the team's work yet. Stay near a teammate with Share nearby open to get the rest.
copy.keepVersion: Until this phone reaches the internet, do not install another version of LangQuest on it. The team's work it got from a teammate would be removed, and a teammate would have to give it again.

nearby.tooOld: This app is too old to share. Update it from the store.
nearby.farAhead: {{name}}'s phone has a date far in the future. Their work waits until it reaches the server.
nearby.olderFromServer: Older work will come from the server.
nearby.holdHelp: On, this phone keeps teammates' recordings until the server has them. Off, it keeps only the ones you need.
nearby.whileOpenHelp: When you have no internet, your phone shares with teammates nearby while LangQuest is open, and stops when the screen goes off. Recordings may wait for Share nearby. Without internet for longer than two weeks, open Share nearby together at least every two weeks to keep it going.
nearby.whileOpenNow: Sharing with teammates nearby while LangQuest is open
nearby.whileOpenOn: On: shares with teammates nearby while LangQuest is open without internet
nearby.whileOpenNeeds: On, but this phone needs something allowed or turned on. Open Share nearby to see what.

carry.title: What this phone holds
carry.everything: This phone holds everything it knows of.
carry.elsewhere: This phone holds as much of {{name}}'s work as it can. The rest stays on {{name}}'s phone until someone reaches the internet.
carry.elsewhereUnknown: Recordings that only phones not nearby hold: {{n}}
carry.noRoom: There is not enough room on this phone for every recording.
carry.notAll: This phone can carry the team's work, but not all of their recordings.
carry.pulled: Changes this phone got from the server can be shared only after it next reaches the internet.
carry.today: Has their work up to {{time}} today
carry.notSinceOnline: Nothing new from them since you were last online
carry.foldToday: Has today's work from every teammate
carry.foldNotSince: Furthest behind: {{name}}, nothing new since you were last online
carry.teamHelp: How recent the newest work on this phone is from each teammate, counting work passed on by another phone. It is not when you last shared with them: a teammate who has not worked today shows an older time. Share nearby brings it up to date.
carry.quietUntil: Shares while LangQuest is open until {{day}}
carry.quietSoon: Open Share nearby together before {{day}} to keep sharing while LangQuest is open
carry.quietLapsed: Not sharing while LangQuest is open. Open Share nearby together.
carry.onlyHereHelp: Your recordings that no teammate's phone holds, as far as this phone knows. Share nearby with a teammate so they are on two phones.

history.nearby: Came from {{name}}'s phone, not on the server yet
history.nearbyUnknown: Came from a teammate's phone, not on the server yet

sync.holdingHelp: Teammates' recordings on this phone that the server does not have yet. They go up when this phone is online.
sync.deliveryRefused: The server would not take {{name}}'s work from this phone: {{reason}}. It stays here and goes again at each sync.

letIn.rowHelp: Opens Let someone in, where a new phone without internet joins your team from this phone.
letIn.intro: A new person with LangQuest on their phone joins your team from this phone, without internet. Choose their role, show them the code, and let them in once the pictures match.
letIn.needsApp: The new phone needs LangQuest installed first.

why.notInBuild: Only Android phones can let someone in.
why.noPass: This phone cannot let anyone in. Your organization must have it turned on, you must be able to invite people to this language, and this phone must have reached the internet since.
why.expired: This phone's permission to let people in has run out. Connect to the internet once to renew it.
why.noRole: There is no role this phone can give without internet. An admin can give roles after the new person reaches the internet.
why.wifiOff: Turn on Wi-Fi in your phone's settings, then come back.
why.usedUp: This phone has let in as many people as it can without internet. Connect to the internet once to let in more.
why.copyNotReady: This phone has not finished downloading the team's work, so it cannot give a new person a copy yet. Connect to the internet until it finishes, then come back.
why.copyFilling: This phone is still getting the team's work: {{filled, number}} of {{total, number}} passages. Connect to the internet until it finishes, then come back.

letIn.daysLeft: Days left to let people in from this phone: {{n, number}}
letIn.renewSoon: Connect to the internet once before they run out, so this phone can go on letting people in. People already let in are not affected.
letIn.roleHelp: The role the new person gets. An admin can change it after they reach the internet.
letIn.asRole: They join as {{role}}. An admin can change it after they reach the internet.
letIn.showHelp: Makes a code for the new phone to scan. It works for two minutes, for one phone. When this phone is still giving the app over its own Wi-Fi, it works for 15 minutes, and the new phone finds it by itself.
letIn.codeLabel: The code for the new phone to scan
letIn.scanLine: On the new phone, open LangQuest, tap Scan a code, and point it here.
letIn.connected: A phone connected. Waiting for it to ask…
letIn.compare: Check that the new phone shows the same two pictures. If they differ, tap No.
letIn.whatGoes: They will get this language's work and the names of its team.
letIn.letInHelp: Lets them in with the role chosen, then sends them a starting copy of this language.
letIn.noHelp: Sends them nothing and ends the connection.
letIn.copying: Sending {{name}} a starting copy… Parts sent: {{n, number}}
letIn.copyRest: {{name}} has the starting copy. Sending the newest work, and guide pictures and audio…
letIn.doneLine: They can work now. Their account is made when their phone, or a teammate's carrying their work, reaches the internet.
letIn.guideFiles: Guide pictures and audio reach them later, the first time they use Share nearby with a teammate over Wi-Fi.
letIn.anotherHelp: Starts again with a new code.
letIn.turnedAway: Another phone tried this code and was turned away.
letIn.stayOpen: Keep this screen open until it finishes.
letIn.getHelp: Opens your phone's browser, which downloads the install file for this version.

getSteps.browser: Your phone's browser opens and downloads the install file.
getSteps.warning: If the browser warns that the file may be harmful, choose to download it anyway. It is LangQuest's own install file.
getSteps.back: When the download has finished, come back to LangQuest. You do not need to open the file.
getSteps.open: When the download finishes, tap Open. LangQuest opens and checks the file.
getSteps.openGone: If Open has gone, come back to LangQuest and tap {{button}}.

letIn.getLine: In the field, send it with Give the app. Quick Share, an SD card or a USB cable also work, but Quick Share needs Google Play services on both phones.
letIn.getLineOther: In the field, send it to the new phone by Quick Share, an SD card or a USB cable. Quick Share needs Google Play services on both phones. The new phone may ask to allow installs from this source.
letIn.getOffline: Downloading the install file needs the internet.
letIn.check: Choose a file you already have
letIn.checkHelp: Opens your phone's files. Choose an install file you got another way, such as from a teammate or an SD card, and the app checks it is the one this phone needs.
letIn.chooseHelp: Opens your phone's files. Choose the install file the browser downloaded, and the app checks it is the one this phone needs.
letIn.chooseLine: When the download has finished, tap Choose the downloaded file. It is usually first among your recent files.
letIn.chooseLineOpen: If you did not tap Open in the browser, LangQuest does not have the file yet. When the download has finished, tap Choose the downloaded file. It is usually first among your recent files.
letIn.getAgainHelp: Opens your phone's browser again, for when the download did not finish.
letIn.checkOther: This file is for a different version: you need {{file}}
letIn.fileHelp: When everyone you came for is in, delete this file. You need internet to get it again.
letIn.picturesLabel: Two pictures. Compare them with the other phone.

end.expired: Nobody used the code in time. Make a new one.
end.noAnswer: The phone that connected did not have this code. Make a new one.
end.versions: Their app is a different version. They need {{file}}
end.versionsUnnamed: Their app is a different version. They need the install file for this phone's version.
end.clock: The two phones' clocks differ by more than five minutes. Set the right time on the new phone, then make a new code.
end.refused: This phone could not let them in under that role. Connect to the internet once, then try again.
end.dropped: The connection dropped before they were let in. Make a new code.
end.droppedAfter: They are in, but the connection dropped. Any teammate with Share nearby open can finish their starting copy.
end.droppedDocs: They are in and can start working, but the connection dropped before everything came. Any teammate with Share nearby open can give them the rest.
end.copyShort: They are in, but this phone had no starting copy to give them yet. Any teammate with Share nearby open can finish it.
end.stopped: The code is gone because you left this screen. Make a new one.
end.noCertificate: This phone must connect to the internet once before it can let anyone in.
end.failed: Something went wrong on this phone. Make a new code.

keep.keeping: Keeping a copy on this phone…
keep.kept: A copy is kept on this phone for Give the app. You can delete the one in Downloads.
keep.notOurs: This is not LangQuest's own install file. Download it again while you have internet.
keep.noSpace: Not enough room on this phone to keep a copy. Free some space and choose it again.
keep.unreadable: This file could not be read. Choose it again.
keep.failed: A copy could not be kept. Choose it again.
keep.needsAndroid: This phone keeps no copy: Give the app needs Android 10 or later.
keep.needsUpdate: This phone keeps no copy yet. Update the app from the store to give it over Wi-Fi.
keep.keptBuilt: A copy built on {{date}} is kept on this phone for Give the app. You can delete the one in Downloads.

letIn.scanLineGive: On the new phone, open LangQuest. It finds this phone by itself. If it does not, tap Scan a code and point it here.

installFile.intro: A new person's phone needs LangQuest installed before you can let them in. Download the install file here while you have internet, and take it with you.
installFile.rowHelp: Opens Download the install file, where you download the file a new phone installs LangQuest from and keep a copy. Do it while you have internet.
installFile.linkHelp: Opens Download the install file, where you download the file a new phone installs LangQuest from and keep a copy.
installFile.notGot: No install file for a new person yet
installFile.older: Install file for a new person: for an older version
installFile.notChosen: Install file for a new person: not chosen yet
installFile.lineHelp: You need this file to give LangQuest to a new person offline. Download it while you have internet.
installFile.old: Your install file is for an older version. Download the new one.
installFile.downloaded: Downloaded. Choose the file to finish.
installFile.title: Install file for a new person
installFile.ready: Ready to give to a new person.
installFile.done: Ready. You can take it offline.
installFile.newer: A newer install file is ready. Download it while you have internet, then choose it.
installFile.newerShort: Install file for a new person: a newer one is ready

join.intro: Join your team from a teammate's phone, without internet. Your account is made the first time your phone reaches the internet.
join.notInBuild: Joining without internet needs an Android phone.

notEmpty.title: This phone already holds someone's work
notEmpty.session: Someone is signed in on this phone. A new person can join without internet only on a phone with nobody on it.
notEmpty.others: Someone has used LangQuest on this phone before. A new person can join without internet only on a phone with nobody on it.
notEmpty.unsent: This phone holds work that has not reached the server. A new person can join without internet only on a phone with nobody on it.
notEmpty.local: Someone has already joined on this phone without internet. Only one person can.

join.noCode: Scan the code on your teammate's phone first.
join.name: Your name
join.nameHelp: The name your teammate sees before letting you in.
join.nameLine: When you tap Join, Android asks to let LangQuest use nearby devices. It needs this to reach your teammate's phone.
join.stale: This code may be too old. If joining fails, ask for a new one.
join.joinHelp: Reaches your teammate's phone and asks to be let in.
join.permission: LangQuest needs the Nearby devices permission (Location on older phones) to reach your teammate's phone.
join.permissionBlocked: Allow Nearby devices or Location for LangQuest in the phone's settings, then come back.
join.wifiOff: Turn on Wi-Fi in your phone's settings, then try again.
join.compare: Your teammate's phone shows two pictures. If they are the same as these, your teammate lets you in.
join.copying: You are in. Getting a starting copy of the team's work… Parts: {{n, number}}
join.unfinished: You are in, but the starting copy is not complete
join.unfinishedLine: Any teammate with Share nearby open on the same version of the app can finish it. Or it finishes by itself when this phone reaches the internet.
join.lookHelp: Finds a teammate's phone nearby to finish the starting copy.
join.looking: Looking for a teammate with Share nearby open…
join.stopLookingHelp: Stops looking. You can look again later.
join.otherVersion: A teammate's app is a different version
join.otherVersionLine: Their phone cannot finish your starting copy. A teammate on the same version can, or the internet will.
join.installFile: This phone no longer needs the install file. You can delete it, unless you will pass it on.
join.guideFiles: Guide pictures and audio come later, the first time you use Share nearby with a teammate over Wi-Fi.
join.scanHelp: Opens the scanner for a new code from your teammate's phone.

end.notLetIn: You were not let in. Ask your teammate for a new code if you should be.
end.noAnswer: Your teammate's phone did not answer. Ask for a new code.
end.clock: This phone's clock differs from your teammate's by more than five minutes. Set the right date and time, then scan a new code.
end.versions: Your app is a different version from your teammate's. Ask them for their install file, install it, then scan a new code.
end.refused: This phone could not check your teammate's answer. Ask for a new code.
end.dropped: The connection dropped. Ask for a new code.
end.failed: Something went wrong on this phone. Ask for a new code.

give.intro: Give LangQuest to a new phone. Neither phone needs the internet.
give.rowSub: When you are with the new person
give.rowHelp: Opens Give the app, where this phone sends LangQuest to a new phone over a Wi-Fi network it makes itself.
give.linkHelp: Opens Give the app, to send LangQuest to the new phone over a Wi-Fi network this phone makes.
give.startHelp: Makes this phone's Wi-Fi network for the new phone to join, and shows the first code.
give.noFile: First download the install file while you have internet.

unsupported.android: Give the app needs Android 10 or later, and this phone has an older version. Send the install file by Quick Share, an SD card or a USB cable instead.
unsupported.update: This version of the app cannot give the app. Update it from the store.

join.title: 1. Join this phone's Wi-Fi network
join.line: On the new phone, open the camera, point it at this code and tap Join. When it has joined, the second code shows by itself. If it does not, tap Next.
join.lineAgain: On the new phone, open the camera, point it at this code and tap Join.
join.code: Code for joining this phone's Wi-Fi network
join.typeLine: Or, in the new phone's Wi-Fi settings, choose this network and type the password:

give.nextHelp: Shows the second code, for the download page, once the new phone has joined.

download.title: 2. Open the download page
download.line: Point the new phone's camera at this code and open the page. The download starts by itself. If it does not, tap Download.
download.warnings: If the new phone's browser says the file can't be downloaded securely, choose to keep it. If it warns that the file may be harmful, choose to download it anyway. It is LangQuest's own install file.
download.address: Or type this address in its browser: {{address}}
download.dataLine: The new phone may say this Wi-Fi has no internet. Tap Stay connected. If the page still does not open, turn off its mobile data.

give.backToJoinHelp: Shows the code for joining this phone's Wi-Fi network again.
give.sentLine: The file is sent. On the new phone, open the downloaded file and tap Install. It may ask once to allow installs from this source. Then let them in from this phone.
give.sentLineFinds: The file is sent. On the new phone, open the downloaded file and tap Install. It may ask once to allow installs from this source. When LangQuest is installed and open on the new phone, it finds this phone by itself. Tap Let them in and choose their role.
give.anotherHelp: Shows both codes again, for one more new phone.
give.letInHelp: Opens Let someone in, to let the new phone join the team.
give.stopHelp: Turns off this phone's Wi-Fi network.
give.stayOpen: Keep this screen open until the file is sent.

ended.idle: Stopped after 15 minutes with no phone downloading.
ended.phone: Stopped because Wi-Fi turned off or you left the app.

failed.wifiOff: Turn on Wi-Fi on this phone, then try again.
failed.permission: LangQuest needs the Nearby devices permission (Location on older phones) to make its Wi-Fi network. Allow it, then try again.
failed.busy: This phone's Wi-Fi is busy. Wait a moment, then try again.
failed.failed: This phone's Wi-Fi network did not start. Try again.
failed.permissionCovered: Open Share nearby first and allow what it asks. Then come back and try again.

quickShare.help: Opens this phone's share sheet with the install file.
quickShare.failed: The share sheet did not open. Try again.
quickShare.letInHelp: Opens Let someone in, to let them in once LangQuest is installed on the new phone.

steps.open: Swipe down from the top of the screen and tap Quick Share. If it is not there, open Settings and search for Quick Share.
steps.visible: Choose Everyone, so this phone can find it. Keep it close by, with its screen on.
steps.send: Tap Send with Quick Share. In the share sheet, tap Quick Share, then the new phone's name.
steps.accept: Tap Accept. When the file has arrived, tap Open. If Open has gone, find the file in the Files app, under Downloads.
steps.letIn: When LangQuest is installed and open on the new phone, tap Let them in.
steps.install: Allow installs from this source, if the phone asks. Tap Install.

page.title: Install LangQuest
page.stepOpen: The download starts by itself. If it does not, tap Download. When it finishes, tap Open.
page.stepFind: If Open has gone, find {{name}} in Downloads, in the browser's menu ⋮ or in the Files app, and tap it.
page.stepAllow: Allow installs from this source, if the phone asks.
page.stepJoin: Open LangQuest. It finds your teammate's phone by itself. If it does not, come back to this page and tap Join.

give.ways: Choose one way to send it

way.wifiSub: The new phone scans two codes. Works on any Android phone.
way.quickShareSub: Both phones need Google Play services.

give.wayHelp: Chooses this way to send the install file. Its steps and its button show below.
give.wifiLine: This phone makes its own Wi-Fi network. The new phone scans two codes with its camera: one to join the network, one to download LangQuest.
